title: Large Language Models are Geographically Biased

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to provide zero-shot numerical ratings (on a scale of 0.0 to 9.9) for sensitive subjective topics (e.g., attractiveness, morality, intelligence) based on specific geographic coordinates, and analyzing the spatial distribution of rank errors to identify systemic regional overestimates or underestimates.

Measuring the Spearman rank correlation between the models' geographically-anchored ratings on subjective topics and ground-truth socioeconomic indicators, specifically using infant survival/mortality rates as a proxy for socioeconomic conditions.
